about: Ratios, odds and map scales read 'to', not as clock times (loop B161, CROSS X-063). BookLyre's 33 cases from EpubToM4B tests/fixtures/spoken_ratios.json (auto/loop 9cc06cfb, BACKLOG #238) in Backseat's own spoken numbers, plus map-scale and clock cases. A colon between numbers reads 'to' when a ratio word is among the 3 words before it in its clause, a ratio noun follows, or the right side is 1; verses, am/pm, 'at 1:50', hh:mm:ss, chains and decimals are not ratios (their expected values are Backseat's ordinary reading). Backseat Driver: backseat::pronunciation::ForSpeech / Ratios (libs/backseat/backseat_tests/pronunciation_test.cpp).
